description: This file defines constants, macros, and function prototypes related to system events (sys events) for WAN management, including IPv4/IPv6 states, WAN status, and network configurations.

methods.name: WanMgr_SysEvents_Init
methods.description: Initializes system event handling for WAN management.

methods.name: WanMgr_SysEvents_Finalise
methods.description: Finalizes or cleans up system event handling.

methods.name: wanmgr_sysevents_ipv6Info_init
methods.description: Initializes IPv6 related system event values.

methods.name: wanmgr_sysevents_ipv4Info_init
methods.description: Initializes IPv4 related system event values with interface name and device mode.

methods.name: wanmgr_set_Ipv4Sysevent
methods.description: Stores IPv4 DHCP information into system events.

methods.name: wanmgr_sysevents_ipv4Info_set
methods.description: Sets IPv4 information in system events based on DHCP data and interface name.

methods.name: wanmgr_sysevents_setWanState
methods.description: Sets the WAN state indicator in system events.

methods.name: wanmgr_sysevent_hw_reconfig_reboot
methods.description: Triggers a system reboot for reconfiguration.

methods.name: wanmanager_mapt_feature
methods.description: Checks if MAPT feature is enabled.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetWanStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current WAN status.

methods.name: wanmgr_setwanstart
methods.description: Starts WAN interface.

methods.name: wanmgr_setwanstop
methods.description: Stops WAN interface.

methods.name: wanmgr_sshd_restart
methods.description: Restarts SSH daemon.

methods.name: wanmgr_services_restart
methods.description: Restarts network services.

methods.name: wanmgr_setwanrestart
methods.description: Restarts WAN interface.

methods.name: wanmgr_isWanStarted
methods.description: Checks if WAN is started.

methods.name: WanMgr_IsWanStopped
methods.description: Checks if WAN is stopped.

methods.name: wanmgr_firewall_restart
methods.description: Restarts firewall.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetWanServiceStatus
methods.description: Gets WAN service status.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetWanRoutedStatus
methods.description: Gets WAN routed status.

methods.name: wanmgr_isWanStandby
methods.description: Checks if WAN is in standby mode.

methods.name: WanMgr_CheckDefaultRA
methods.description: Checks and toggles default Router Advertisement for IPv6.

methods.name: Force_IPv6_toggle
methods.description: Toggles IPv6 on the specified interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_Configure_accept_ra
methods.description: Configures IPv6 accept_ra setting on a virtual interface.

methods.name: wanmgr_get_wan_interface
methods.description: Retrieves current WAN interface name.

methods.name: wanmgr_setWanLedState
methods.description: Sets the WAN LED state indicator.
